title: Warranty and Safety Recall Coverage — Repair Conditions and Exclusion Switches
content:
# Repair Conditions and Exclusion Switches

The Warranty and Safety Recall Coverage sets six yes-or-no conditions for each coverage type. They govern wear items, environmental damage, aftermarket parts, maintenance done outside the group, payment for diagnosis and repairs needed to pass a state emissions inspection.

## What each switch means when set to Yes

| Switch | Meaning when Yes |
|---|---|
| Wear items excluded | wear items (pads, rotors, wiper blades, tires, filters) are excluded |
| Environmental damage excluded | hail, flood, fire and road-salt damage are excluded |
| Aftermarket parts do not void | the use of aftermarket or recycled parts leaves the coverage in force (a claim is refused only for a failure that part caused) |
| Independent maintenance accepted | maintenance done by any shop or by the owner, with records, satisfies the maintenance requirement |
| Diagnosis paid when covered | diagnosis is paid by the coverage when the failure is covered |
| Emissions inspection failure covered | a repair needed to pass a state emissions inspection is covered |

## Settings by coverage type

| Coverage type | Wear items excluded | Environmental damage excluded | Aftermarket parts do not void | Independent maintenance accepted | Diagnosis paid when covered | Emissions inspection failure covered |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kessler Used Vehicle Limited Warranty | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No |
| Factory Complimentary Maintenance | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No |
| Factory Basic Limited Warranty | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No |
| Factory Powertrain Limited Warranty | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No |
| Certified Pre-Owned Powertrain Warranty | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No |
| Federal Emissions Performance Warranty | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Safety Recall Remedy Coverage | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No |

## Reading the table

- The first five switches are set to Yes for all seven coverage types.
- The emissions inspection switch is Yes for the Federal Emissions Performance Warranty alone and No for the other six coverage types.
